subject: Validation Playbook & Ownership for Q3 Trial
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@greenloophealth.com>; Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & proposed validation scope — next steps

Hi Alice (and team),

Thanks again for the time today — quick recap and proposed path for the Q3 trial so we can lock on owners and timing.

Call summary (short):
- Goal: validate inference cost and latency for batch inference on 10M records + 1:1 API for patient-facing responses (peak 50 TPS).
- Success criteria (what GreenLoop needs to see):
  * 95th pctl latency <= 200ms for 1:1 API at 50 TPS,
  * Average embedding cost <= $0.0008 / vector across workloads,
  * No PII leakage in logs; evidence of KMS encryption in transit & at rest.
- Proposed trial scope: 2-week smoke + 4-week evaluation with staged load steps.

Asks for this thread:
1) Please confirm GreenLoop infra and security contacts (so we can route network/kms questions).
2) Confirm procurement timeline for a simple trial SOW (we can do a limited credit-based trial if procurement needs more time).
3) Review the attached validation-checklist.xlsx and network-reqs.pdf — I flagged items we expect Redwood to own vs what needs GreenLoop pre-provisioning.

Next steps (suggested):
- Wed 07/29: Sizing sync (30m) to confirm VM/GPU targets — attendees: Jonas (runtime), Infra lead (GreenLoop), Rachel (solutions).
- Fri 08/07: Start smoke tests (if infra ready).

Attachments: validation-checklist.xlsx (xlsx), network-reqs.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — I’ll draft a short RACI in the next email so everyone sees who’s responsible for infra, app, security and procurement.

--
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@greenloophealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: InfraOps Team <infraops@greenloophealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@greenloophealth.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 17:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap & proposed validation scope — next steps

Thanks Karthik — good summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- GreenLoop contacts: Michael Park (Infrastructure Lead) — michael.park@greenloophealth.com, Samantha Li (Security) — samantha.li@greenloophealth.com. Please include them on the sizing sync.
- Procurement: we can turn a short SOW (~6 weeks) if needed. Procurement is tentatively targeting PO by Aug 20; Procurement will provide final wording on license and data handling.
- Success criteria: the latency and cost targets look reasonable; one additional ask — we need a short audit path showing token-level logging can be disabled and that KMS integration proofs are available for SOC reviewers.

We reviewed the checklist and added a few infra items (see network-reqs.pdf). We do not need the full SOW yet — a short trial SOW is fine to get started.

Alice
Head of Partnerships | GreenLoop Health
alice.nguyen@greenloophealth.com

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: RACI draft — GreenLoop validation playbook (please review)

Team — drafting a compact RACI we can share with GreenLoop. Keep it tight so procurement can approve quickly. I put initials next to Redwood owners; adjust if you disagree.

RACI (working draft):
- Infra (network, VPC peering, firewall rules):
  R: Michael Park (GreenLoop)  | A: Michael Park  | C: Jonas Weber (Redwood runtime)  | I: Rachel Kim
- Redwood runtime & config (model variant, batching, KV cache):
  R: Jonas Weber (Redwood)  | A: Jonas Weber  | C: Marissa Cole (CS)  | I: GreenLoop Infra
- App integration (API contract, auth):
  R: GreenLoop app team  | A: GreenLoop app lead  | C: Karthik Iyer (AE)  | I: Marissa Cole
- Security & compliance (KMS, logging policy, SOC artifacts):
  R: Samantha Li (GreenLoop)  | A: Samantha Li  | C: Soojin Lee (Redwood security)  | I: Procurement
- Procurement & SOW signoff (trial credits, liability):
  R: Procurement (GreenLoop)  | A: Procurement  | C: Rachel Kim  | I: Ben Carter
- Success criteria & evaluation (metric collection, dashboards):
  R: Marissa Cole (Redwood CS)  | A: Marissa Cole  | C: Jonas Weber  | I: GreenLoop Eng

Open questions for the thread:
1) Jonas — can you confirm we can provide KMS integration proof (audit logs + config snippets) by Aug 6? Mark as "C" above if you need R from Security.
2) Soojin — agree that Redwood will provide a redacted audit sample and a token-logging-off walkthrough; can you own that deliverable?
3) Ben/Karthik — do we want to offer a credit-backed trial SOW to shorten procurement? I can draft the short SOW for approval.

I attached a SOW draft we can start from. Please reply with edits or "LGTM" so I can send to GreenLoop.

Attachments: sow-draft-greenloop.docx

--
Rachel Kim
